The '''Detonator Model 3E''' was a type of [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]] manufactured by [[TasCorp]]. It could be attached to TasCorp's [[blaststick]]s and programmed with a one-[[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] time delay.<ref name="J15" />
